summary.en: The frame tears into 16 uneven bands that jitter sideways; the hard cut to the next scene hides in the strongest jitter, then the bands settle.
summary.zh: 整屏切成 16 条不等高横条左右错位抖动，抖得最猛时硬切到下一场，再抖几下归位。

fits: A state jump of the same screen: deploying → live, before → after, off → on; two scenes on one grid.
notFor: Calm or warm films; two unrelated scenes (it then reads as a broken page); more than once a minute.

intent.en: The system switches state in one jolt: the page tears into bands but stays whole, so the viewer reads a digital jump, not a broken screen.
intent.zh: 系统一下子跳到新状态：页面撕成横条但每条完整，观众读到的是数字式跳变，而不是页面坏了。

content.en: Wraps two scenes of the same screen on one grid (before and after a state change); no text of its own; the scenes need an opaque ground.
content.zh: 包住同一界面的两个状态（同一网格的前后两场）；自身不带文字；两场都要有不透明的底。

fits.zh: 同一界面的状态跳变：部署中 → 已上线、前 → 后、关 → 开；同一网格上的两场。

notFor.zh: 安静或温暖的片子；两场毫不相关（读成页面坏了）；一分钟内用两次以上。

pairs.note: a status word landing right after the jump

en: Bands only, never blocks: once the page breaks into tiles it reads as destroyed.
The cut must hide in the strongest jitter; a cut on a still frame loses the cover.
High-energy seam: keep it away from other loud transitions (whip, crash) or they cancel out.
zh: 只做横条，不碎成方块；一碎块就读成页面被破坏。
硬切必须藏在抖得最猛的那几帧；切在静止帧上就失去掩护。
高能转场：别和甩镜、撞击等其他响的转场挤在一起，互相抵消。

upstream.name: 故障条带错位
upstream.summary: 撕裂转场——glitch-displace 噪声撕裂（16 横条错位抖动中硬切），数字故障语义的条带级撕裂
upstream.use: 高能换页：数字故障/断裂语义；页面完整性不破、能量拉满的条带级撕裂

overlaps.note: frame-level slices that smear the scenes into each other; this one keeps each band whole and cuts
